verdict.rationale: Medusa documents its own official CLI and a Cloud CLI, and it supports GitHub-driven deploys with PR previews, so scripted, non-interactive operation is plausible. However, the pack only names these features; it does not describe how to run Medusa in CI pipelines or other unattended automation. missing for 10: documented CI/headless automation workflow (e.g., non-interactive CLI flags, CI pipeline examples, auth tokens for automation), detail on Cloud CLI capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
